reviews.text: Had a great experience and he doctor was so sweet to my senior baby ❤️
Hands-down, the best services a dog mom could ever receive
Detailed and understanding
This place is fast, efficient and clean. The staff are all very nice and accommodating.

We’re so grateful to the vets Dr. Agel / Dr. Luevano and our fabulous technician, Christina for taking such wonderful care of our puppy! They were able to get us in so quickly and treated our puppy with so much kindness and care. We truly appreciate everything they did and highly recommend them!

I had the most amazing servace!!!! Dr.Alderholdt, Roberto, Christina, Sher, &Jaced thank you for everything you all did for Cujo.
The Lakewood staff where amazing! 10 out of 10 i would recommend.

A couple of weeks ago, I took my fur baby Gotti to Modern Animal Lakewood because my regular veterinarian was unavailable and referred me to them. I just want to give a HUGE shoutout to Christina and Dr. Aderholt ❤️🐾
They were absolutely amazing! They took their time explaining everything that was going on with my fur baby and were so gentle, patient, and caring with him. The customer service was EVERYTHING, and the facility was super clean! It's such a great feeling knowing your fur baby is in good hands. Thank you, Christina and Dr. Aderholt,  for taking such great care of my baby! I definitely give Modern Animal Lakewood 5 STARS! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 🐶❤

My dog has received nothing but the best care from Modern Animal staff; however, you cannot count on having your pet be seen when they are sick. My dog got sick on a Wednesday. I tried to make an appointment for Friday and none were available. By Sunday, I saw my dog can only go to the Addison location or would need to wait until Wednesday to be seen. After contacting their online care team, there was no way to get my dog in sooner. This was never the case before Chewy bought out Modern Animal. Despite the great care from the staff, I am now looking for a new vet who I can count on when my dog needs it the most.

The vets were very kind and explained everything to me as a first time cat owner. They answered all my questions and even offered me a beverage for the visit! They were very gentle with my kitten and got through everything in a very timely manner. 10/10 reccomend!

We left our old vet because they got bought out by a mobile only vet service. SO glad we switched to Modern Animal. The thing that made us come was the weekend availability and the urgent care option. The thing that will make us stay was how helpful, friendly, and informative the staff and doctor was. So happy to have them care for my fur baby.

I really loved this place when I first brought my pets. But I can never get an appointment. I bought the yearly memberships, which are great if you have a routine check up that can get scheduled far out. But for urgent issues I can't get an appointment. That defeats the purpose of the membership plan, as I wind up having to go to another clinic for assistance. I also don't like that you can't call someone - all communication is through the app. Originally a great concept, but not great in reality for my pet needs. When I chatted in the app about the issue, there were no apologies, not even an attempt to get my pet in. I wound up cancelling my memberships.

We adopted a baby mix dog and we were referred to Modern Clinic and we appreciate the help and knowledge they shared with us in caring for a baby girl: Lady Canelita. She loves the bone they gave her since she is teething.
Christina & Dr luevano were amazing

Overall, the experience was OK. The doctor was a bit uppity.  I also called before to make sure that it was a free office visit and when I tried to leave, they told me that I owed them $25. I explained that I only came in to try them out because it was a free pet exam, Eventually, they figured out how to not charge me However, I sat there for about 15 minutes, waiting for them to give me the OK. When they finally gave me the pricing the next day for my dog dental, it was literally $1800. Yes, they get all sorts of additional care however it's about $800 more than a normal vet. I would shop around
My experience was wonderful, I highly recommend this place. They treated my dogs very well, with lots of love and patience. We felt cared for and looked after. I wholeheartedly recommend it.

This was our first appt with Modern Animal and we had such a great experience. Dr. Luevano wad so professional, understanding, communicative, and caring. She understood our dog’s reactive personality and was so accomdating. She helped make a stressful appt for our dog into something so manageable and made sure our dog was comfortable the entire time. Also the vet assistant, Alexis, was just as amazing and professional! I could not be anymore happier with our visit.
really quick nice service!

Thank you for your review, Holly! We appreciate feedback as it's the only way we can improve. I will be reaching out via the Modern Animal app to see how we might have adjusted to make your experience with us worthy of that 5th star. We hope Howard is doing well after his visit with us!
Nice and knowledgeable team, clean environment and overall very professional operation…I look forward using Modern Animal Lakewood as the primary vet for my new cat.
They took very good care of my oddball would totally recommend to anyone
She was very sweet to my cat when we visited, very transparent with what was going on and the prices, and willing to answer the questions I had.
Thank you for your review, Julia! We hope that Simon is doing well after his visit with us. If there is anything else we can do for you, please let us know!
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Michael! We’re glad to see you enjoyed your experience. Your support means a lot to us, and we look forward to serving you again soon!

Skye recovering at Modern Animal Lakewood clinic. Skye has been having brown urin , discharge and not feeling well.  This vet clinic is amazing, they sedated her, took a urin culture, sonogram, blood work all while treating her like human . They also did some of the work complimentary, the only thing they charged me for was the sedation medication and the blood and urin test to get sent out, 650.00 total. They are more about getting your pet the help they need then how much they get paid. I will never go any place else.
Modern animal truly provides the best care & is always a great experience
Very friendly and professional staff. Dr Luevano took time to explain about my cat's condition and treatment plan.

Amazing staff!!! I came in hysterical because my frenchie Kaia was showing bad symptoms and not only did they help her and diagnose her and give her medicine they calmed me down and explained to me what was the issue and how to address it. 1000/1000 would recommend to everyone
Staff was super nice and helpful.  Very clean and calming atmosphere.  Was very sweet to my little Tiny. ❤️

This was my first experience at Modern Animal Lakewood and it was amazing! They were extremely transparent about the pricing. They also were sweet to my anxious chihuahua ♥️ Winnie left smiling even after 3 shots and bloodwork! Plus they give you free cold brew! Shout out Dr.Dummicci and Lvt. Alexis! You girlies make a great team!

All of the staff, from the front desk to VTs to vets, are compassionate and helpful. The love and care they show my pets when we visit is so appreciated. The annual membership has more than paid itself off especially for my senior dog, who has needed a lot of care recently. The 24/7 virtual care feature gives me peace of mind. I highly recommend Modern Animal!

Staff are always friendly, but be cautious of unauthorized charges. My goldendoodle had eye surgery and was billed over $500 for dental work I didn’t approve. Prior messages through their system with the vet indicated he didn’t need it, but they performed the work during his stay anyway. I received no response when I reached out, not even an acknowledgment. This happened at the Park Cities location but the staff work at all 3 locations in the area.

I've always loved this clinic, everyone has always been non-judgemental, considerate, and friendly.

Even though I ask a million questions and also have the most annoying dog ever, Chippy's care has always been very personalized. I've especially enjoyed my interactions with the new vet Dr. Matthias Mitra, the old vet Dr. Cristina Mastromonaco, and the vet tech Alexis who are all so friendly, caring, and patient.

I think their pricing is slightly high, but mostly fair, and they're very transparent about the reasoning and more affordable alternatives. Plus they accept Affirm which is great.

I do also have their membership which I think is worth the money especially for puppies, or dogs prone to trouble (like my little demon). Free unlimited visits, 24/7 virtual care, and discounts on everything are a pretty good deal for 1 affordable payment a year.

My only complaint is with their 24/7 virtual care. I would sometimes ask simple questions, and their response was always to book an appointment even if it was unnecessary. And I know it was unnecessary because in one instance when I called an ER (after virtual said to take Chips to the er asap), they agreed that it's okay to wait and see if symptoms worsen. In another instance I asked for food recommendations and they also directed me to book an appointment with the clinic, and when I got there the Vet agreed it didn't require a visit and I stressed my dog out for nothing 🙃.

Overall great clinic that I'll continue going to as long as I'm in Dallas. :)

Modern Animal has performed surgeries on my cat and dog as well as a primary care visit for my other elderly cat. The vets/techs kept me well informed every step of the way through both surgeries, and I could tell my animals were well taken care of. Highly recommend Modern Animal for primary care and surgical needs!

Finding a new vet is stressful, but Modern Animal made it easy. The entire team was amazing with my 15-year-old cat. They explained everything clearly and ensured I felt comfortable every step of the way. Highly recommend!
Caring and personal.  We have a senior dog and Dr Dammicci was very empathetic not also informative.
highly recommend, had a good experience for Demi
Excellent communication and care

Since Christmas, it’s been a whirlwind of emotions! My 10-year-old dog has always had a sensitive tummy but nothing like this. I immediately called Modern Animal and spoke to a nurse named Ashley whom got me scheduled for my appointment. Then I spoke to Alexis who helped me figure out what kind of treatment I needed before I showed up to my appointment and while at my appointment, Miss Alyshia in Dr. Mitra were amazing! So patient and accommodating. I left with tears in my eyes from the relief. Going to the vet is always a scary situation especially with a senior dog! Thank you, Modern Animal for a pleasant experience.

Metrow Paws has been my  veterinarian clinic for 17 years. They’re amazing.!
The entire team,
Dr.Adams and her staff were extraordinary during Scouts. Time of need.. they fought alongside us every step of the way,
With compassion honesty and unwavering dedication. making sure that Scott was surrounded by care and Love even when the outcome Wasn’t what we hoped for? my sons and I always knew that he was in the best hands. we are forever grateful for their kindness, love and support. and highly recommend Metro 🐾 Paws for anyone truly looking for exceptional veterinary care they are the best! We thank you from the bottom of our heart. Colleen Christopher, Dimitri..
First time taking our French bulldog” nugget” And I can say, they welcomed us in with a lot of ease with dealing with A very bad ear infection.  Thank you again for helping our nuggs 💙 …

I am so happy with the quality of care at all the modern animal locations! All of the employees seem to be great listeners and are knowledgeable. I’m grateful this location is open on Saturdays. I’ve gone to three modern animal locations in two states and I have no complaints. Glad I became a member

Taylor and Dr. Mitra were fabulous. Lucia is a doll! He's normally terrified of the vet and they made it amazing. Get the membership it's worth it! Thank you to the full team can't thank you guys enough!

I am very thankful to Dr.Dammicci and her team today! My baby Milo had a dental procedure and I was very anxious about it. The staff made sure to keep me very updated and sent me a cute picture of my sweet boy. I am so happy to have Modern Animal as our vet!
Great experience, excellent service the staff was friendly and knowledgeable about my pet needs

Truly the best experience every time. They saw our senior dog through a tough time and were always so sympathetic and objective in their opinions and suggestions. Always a familiar face and they are all always so kind.
Very kind and patient.

We have been going to this vet since we got our puppy in November and it is nothing short of amazing. Love the office, the app and the staff. Dr Christina Mastromonaco takes her time, lets you ask questions, fully explains things and sends the most detailed post care summaries after each appointment. She goes above and beyond each time.

We have also had the pleasure of having LVT, Alexis and Lucia assist us and both are amazing at what they do as well.

Cannot recommend Modern Animal enough!

I had an excellent experience at Modern Animal with my border collie, Roger. From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly kind and helpful. Usually he gets nervous, but the relaxing environment—coupled with an awesome team that handled him with such calm professionalism—made him noticeably more relaxed than usual.

What really stood out to me was the transparent pricing and the overall modern, no-stress approach. Dr. Cristina, Lucia and Sher were amazing. Everything was clearly explained, with no surprises. The level of care and attention they provided made it clear that they genuinely care about both pets and people.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for the kind of top-tier veterinary care you’d expect in 2025!
Very Clean inside, pleasant smell, all smiling faces. Very gentle and patient with my kitten! 10/10 I do recommend!

exceptional care for my little kiwi

edit: unfortunately they fired the best tech they had. he saved my cat's life????
Hi cheryl, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Very friendly, helpful, and honest staff.

Modern Animal is an AMAZING vet clinic! Even for my very first visit when I moved to Texas I was able to make my appointment online and quickly answer some questions that allowed Modern Animal to contact my out-of-state vet for my dog’s records! The staff is incredibly friendly and very knowledgeable, providing recommendations on other options for my dog’s allergies so I have choices. Also, their app is so awesome!! All of my dog’s records, upcoming appointments, previous appointments, and care instructions are in there! The vets and staff also messaged me through the app during my dog’s teeth cleaning and kept me up-to-date with how he’s doing and what’s happening! I love this place!!

Alex and his team were exceptional! They made my pup feel so at home and provided the best care possible. We were provided with options for treatment with transparent pricing. The membership is definitely worth the investment as well.

When my previous vet didn't have any appointments available when I needed them, I tried out Modern Animal. It has been great! My dog had a problem with his eye, and after our first exam they stayed in contact to follow his progress. When it was clear he needed surgery, the doctor made room in her schedule to quickly operate. Our family is is very grateful. On top of our experience, I've found "the app" they use to be very helpful. You can communicate and send photos any time of day, and the messages are being monitored and sent to the doctors if appropriate. And, all your records are a tap away. I'm glad I found Modern Animal.

I can’t say enough good things about Modern Animal! The care for my dog has always been outstanding.

My dog is pretty reactive at the vet and can be hard to deal with (dachshund…) but I know I can trust them to do everything possible to get him the best care despite his attitude! He’s really warmed up to Alex, one of the nurse/techs! He’s always feeding my dog plenty of treats to calm him and make going to the vet a happy trip! I can’t say enough good things!!! Thank you always, Alex!

I’ve even gone to other locations to get the care he needed when our home Lakewood clinic was full and we get the same top notch service! I will gladly pay the membership for years to come!
The vets and staff always take good care of my baby. Great service everytime

Just took my cat there today and the staff were super friendly and welcoming! Our vet tech, Alex, was super sociable, helpful, and hilarious. The environment was warm, inviting, calm, and very well decorated (it's a vibe, seriously). Highly recommend.
Hi Pam, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Very clean and professional.  Everyone from the check in to the  follow up. 🥰 …

Dr. Mastromonaco provided a comfortable visit for my dog and space for an open conversation about options for our dog's health with us. The pricing was very transparent and I didn't feel like I was being pressured to tack a million things on to the list. The office team was also incredibly helpful and attentive to Othello's needs above all else. I'm sure every vet in this practice is amazing, but Dr. Mastromonaco is an ace!
The Lakewood location has great service, great pricing with a very clean and nice facility. My pup Roscoe loved the facility and treatment.
Wonderful experience. Dr. Auerbach treated my pup with care! Highly recommend and will be back.

The staff here treated me better than my own family I will cherish and miss you guys forever thank you so much for being there for me and Pogo when we needed you!! I love Dr. Cristina and the guy sorry I forgot his name but they were the best

I have hesitated for some time before posting this review, but I feel it is important for others to be informed. On the morning of my dog’s appointment, I was asked if I had her vaccination records, which I was unable to locate due to being in the middle of a move. When I inquired if it was required for the visit, I was told it was not, yet I found the last-minute request inconvenient.

Upon arriving at the clinic, I immediately felt uncomfortable, as though I was being judged and watched. My primary concern in seeking a new veterinary clinic was finding a place where my pets’ well-being was prioritized, rather than simply focusing on financial gain. Unfortunately, I sensed a lack of genuine care from the staff. They seemed more focused on each other than on addressing my dog’s needs, and their reactions to her behavior were dismissive, particularly given that she can be quite curious and anxious.

Once the appointment was over, the attitude shifted notably, likely because I demonstrated my commitment to my pet’s care, regardless of cost. I agreed to all of their recommendations, but I left feeling disheartened. Despite paying for the full year’s worth of visits, I cannot see myself returning.

This experience was especially disappointing because I had high hopes after seeing their social media advertisements and reading positive reviews online. However, my concerns were not addressed adequately, and I was only presented with one option for treatment—surgery—which raised doubts about their intentions. I am now seeking a more compassionate and trustworthy clinic for my dog’s ongoing care. I would advise potential clients to carefully consider their options before visiting this facility.
Overall great experience! Will be switching over.

This place is absolutely amazing. They take such great care of your pets and have never laid a hand on my beautiful cat. The staff is incredibly kind and gentle, making every visit a positive experience. One of the best things about them is their app—it allows you to get a quick response from a vet nurse whenever your pet needs help, making everything so much easier and more convenient. My cat actually enjoys going there! She gets a little nervous at first, but she quickly settles down because the team is so warm, patient, and welcoming. I couldn’t ask for a better place to trust with her care.
Very kind vet office! Vet is so caring and informative. Dr. D was wonderful and her associates as well. Barney is doing great
I have been going here for over a year now, and I always receive the best care for my dog
i loved my experience at Modern Animal in Dallas. The doctor and v.a. Alex were super sweet and gave my baby the best care!

What a lovely group of professionals here at MA who are thoughtful, friendly, knowledgeable and truly have a love for animals! I am so thankful I found this place for my Frenchie, Lola! Special shout out to Alex who I’m pretty sure my Lola would have followed home! She loved him. He was so great with her. He was really knowledgeable and generous with his kindness. Thank you Alex!Brilliant staff could not recommend more.

Great vet which has actually usable technology. Super easy to check up on needed care and get the pricing beforehand. Really easy to chat with and get virtual dog care too, which is huge.

Team is really solid, even when busy they take some time to make sure you're getting the best care (shout-out Alex for making the pup comfortable and being engaged)!
Loved the staff and vet. All very kind and compassionate. My dog was relaxed and responded well to their treatment of her.
Hi JKW, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
My experience at Modern Animal has been great so far. Dr. Cristina Mastromonaco has been great along with their amazing technicians! Sher, specially, has been fabulous!!!

This place is great ! Best vet we have been to by far, the membership makes it way more affordable than other visits we have had before with other vets. My dog had an ear infection and it was tough to cure but they provided great care making sure it fully cleared up. They are gentle kind and available to even chat on the app anytime. Highly recommend!

Today was our first time to Modern Animal veterinary clinic and I have to say I was really impressed by the staff and facility! You can tell right away they really care about you and your pet! From the nice lady at the front desk, (I’m sorry I forgot your name), Alex the vet tech, and Dr. Mastromonaco, you all made a very positive first impression to me and our little pup, Sweetie! Alex did a wonderful job listening to our concerns and taking notes and introducing us to the Modern Animal veterinary clinic family practice! Dr. Cristina Mastromonaco did an incredible job of going over Sweeties’s lab results and medical history with me and addressing any concerns we had for Sweetie! Thank you to you and your staff and I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!
As per usual Niko, and Alex along with Dr. Dammicci were amazing! I love seeing them every-time they treat me and my anxious pups with such great care.
Great place for veterinary care!

I toured the clinic earlier this week with Brittany, the clinic manager.

I love that you are able to stay with your pet throughout the entirety of the visit. That is huge for me because my dog has a lot of anxiety and it helps for me to stay with him.

They truly have top tier equipment that I had never seen before in a veterinary clinic and I have been a pet owner the vast majority of my life.

I was SO impressed with the thoughtfulness that went into the design of this clinic. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend bringing your pet for a visit. All of my past vets pale in comparison.
Hi Henrietta, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

I cannot recommend this place any higher to anyone in need of animals services. The staff are very helpful and friendly. They go way beyond regular help though. I had a sticky situation where I lost my pet records and another mess along the …

If I can give no stars, I would. I asked for a manager, Josh about a situation I had prior with a tech name Alexis. I was told he was out at the gym. It was the middle of the day! What manager leaves work to workout? Then I overheard the …
❤️❤️❤️❤️ Mikey is always a happy boy when he go see his extended family. He’s coming out of his shell more and more thank you. What amazing team❤️🐾🐾 …
Alex was great! He was so sweet to our puppy and was very helpful with all of our questions as new pet owners. He was very open and easy to communicate with.

Modern animal is amazing!! My puppy and I just moved to Dallas & this was the best experience we could ever ask for! The vet was so kind & gave us a lot of information about my puppy adjusting to the city life! The Vet MA Alex was …
